verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no query-suggestion feature built from real search traffic and no dedicated suggestions index. Facet search powers type-ahead only over the values of a single facet in filter menus, which is an adjacent feature rather than query suggestions. Analytics tracks queries but is not documented as feeding suggestions, and one community user explicitly says they miss a typeahead feature.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve query suggestions and autocomplete backed by real search traffic or a suggestions index
